overview: The period is dominated by Euclid DR1 strong-lens work: ML classification plus citizen-science/expert grading produced 15,072 candidates and segmentation/mass-modelling pipelines. Simulation-based inference with normalizing flows, flow matching and neural posterior estimation spans DES Y3 cosmic shear, LISA and EMRI gravitational waves, and lens modelling. Benchmarks and releases include COSMIO cross-survey imputation, the FAIR Universe weak-lensing uncertainty challenge, Survey of Surveys DR3 (10.13 million stars), differentiable galpy backends, and Euclid/Rubin foundation models and agent tooling.
themes: Euclid DR1 strong-lens searches and segmentation
Simulation-based inference and flow matching for cosmology and gravitational waves
Neural surrogates and emulators for simulations
Survey foundation models and cross-survey representation learning
Agentic and LLM-based research workflows and benchmarks
